summary: Chapter 1 disposition MODEL_CHANGE_REQUIRED. The update adds RaftMsg::TransferLeader, whose RaftCore branch calls Engine::elect() after checking only vote == from. Every older election path also requires is_voter, so election enablement changed for learners and removed nodes. The reference suite was updated: Elect has a membership-dependent post-state, StartElection == IsVoter /\ Elect, and HandleTransferLeader covers the elect, lease-only and ignored branches. V0 abstractions the update relies on were repaired: full-LogId vote freshness, closed-world vote and append traffic, real follower entries with membership, fresh leader progress, and member-only leader restore. Update.tla adds ElectionInitiatorIsVoter, CandidateIsVoterOfSnapshot, NoCorePanic, EnvUpdate/discharge and canaries. Validation: the V0 harness was rebased and RaftCore window probes added. 34 fresh traces (8 prior scenarios rerun, 4 update unit scenarios, 22 live-cluster windows) pass real TLC replay with TraceMatched and full post-state checks; 27/27 field mutations are rejected; the final regression passes 34/34. Model checking: standard MC.cfg had one Case-B bound artifact, fixed, then no violation in 30 min (51.45M distinct states, depth 27). The full, focused and open update checks find MC-1: TransferLeader to a learner makes it elect, and its RaftCore panics on its own SaveVote self-grant in Candidate::grant_by ('target not in quorum set', Fatal::Panicked). Calling it on every node also deposes the current leader; a removed-node target elects without panicking and disrupts the cluster. MC-1 is reproduced on the real update revision with a public-API test and is absent on the baseline control. Voter-target transfer, crash, open and discharge campaigns show no violation within their BFS and simulation budgets, and every update scenario has a reachability witness. A pre-existing, update-independent observation (MC-2, persisted committed ahead of the leader's durable log with 3 voters) is left NEEDS MORE INFO. All clean results are budget-limited, not proofs.
